plainTranslation: With Composite Pluto in the 3rd house, you may struggle over power and control in your communications, and one of you may constantly try to dominate the conversations you have and what you focus on. You need to make sure you’re hearing one another. You can make major mental transformations together, and have a different view of the world, but you can also be more pessimistic together.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
